    Profile

    Seida is a member of the 2nd Regiment of the Holy Guard. She's the grandchild of the head of the Alize people of Saga. Her unparalleled archery skills and wind-reading capabilities make her one of the best archers of the Holy Guard. She hates inefficiency in word and deed, so she spends a lot of time arguing with Monzein.

    Origin: Saga Region
    Gender: Female
    Height: ―cm
    Weight: ―kg
    Birthday: Feb 20
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Wind Goddess
    Likes: Herbal tea
    Hobbies: Weaving
    Illust: トマル
    CV: 藤野泰子
